annotations.title: Take the next document to read

description: Use during an assistant reading (after geothought_start_agent_reading) to take the next document. Returns `task` and `token` (needed for every call about this document), the `instructions` and the `checklist` of questions (Q1..Qn), and the first `page` of its `sections` (numbered; `pages` says how many pages there are; geothought_document_sections fetches the others). Answer each section only from its text, with verbatim quotes, and send the replies with geothought_submit_replies. The document stays assigned for an hour after each call about it. Returns document: null when none is waiting.
name: geothought_next_document
title: Take the next document to read
